format.acceptNote: 2.9 critic round: all 20 walk-a/walk-b cells are accept:false. Measured foot-cluster positions prove walk-a and walk-b are the SAME stride phase for every fighter (walk-b is the same pose with a wider stance), so the pair is not a cycle; and the bank's build/palette/prop grading parts from the base walk bank, which cannot be blended by interleaving. The locomotion beat is base-only again, exactly as 2.8 shipped it. The art is retained, not deleted. 2.9 critic round 2: the devil's crouch-trans (4) and dash-brake (6) join them at accept:false — both are all-fours prowls, so his crouch press and his dash each played quadruped frames inside an otherwise upright bipedal beat. 138 cells accepted.
format.regenAttempt: 2.9 follow-up, FAILED — the cells stay accept:false and game.js was not touched. Seven prompt-only openai-gpt-image-2 generations across three pilot fighters (deathblow 3, jez 2, benny 2) produced correctly-phased passing poses but could NOT reproduce the base bank's identity: chest band landed -53% to +24% against the base walk mean (10% gate), per-region palette 4.3-10.9 dE, arm-carriage centroid -40% to +19% (15% gate). Round-1 prompts came back too slim; round 2, pushed toward the base bank's heroic mass, overshot into caricature and changed the face. Zero of three passed, so per the pilot rule the remaining seven fighters were not generated. Prompt-only cannot hit a specific existing sprite's build and this fal path has no reference-image input (422, re-confirmed). ALSO MEASURED: the BASE walk bank is single-phase too — in 37 of 40 base walk cells the leading foot is forward of body centre and the trailing foot behind it, and in ZERO cells is that inverted, so no two-cell motion2 patch can make a cycle out of it. See MOTION-ATLAS.md 'Walk regeneration attempt'.
